Discord Voice Mixer FIX — compatibility edition 2.0.1.13

Original plugin by Danol. Maintenance fixes by FarisSoze. GPL-3.0.
This edition intentionally retains cz.danol.discordmixer so it can update the
original plugin in place. It is an unofficial community build, not an update
published by Danol. Existing profiles and user settings are retained.
Source: https://github.com/FarisSoze/StreamDeck-DiscordVolumeMixer2/tree/fix/compat-github-link
